title: Quick check: SEO for Dynamic Routes

questions.prompt: In the context of “SEO for Dynamic Routes” and “Dynamic titles and descriptions”, Where does the App Router define static page metadata?
options: With an exported `metadata` object in the relevant layout or page module.
questions.answer_key: With an exported `metadata` object in the relevant layout or page module.
questions.explanation: The Metadata API supports static metadata exports and dynamic metadata generation for route content.

questions.prompt: While implementing “SEO for Dynamic Routes”, What makes a useful page title and description?
options: Every page uses the same keyword-stuffed title.
They are unique, accurate summaries that match the page’s visible content and purpose.
The description promises content the page does not contain.
The title is generated only from a random number.
questions.answer_key: They are unique, accurate summaries that match the page’s visible content and purpose.
questions.explanation: Metadata should help users and crawlers understand the real page; accuracy is more useful than keyword stuffing.

questions.prompt: When reviewing “SEO for Dynamic Routes”, What should be checked after generating a sitemap or social preview?
options: Assume creating the file proves every URL is indexable.
Publish private dashboard pages in the public sitemap.
Omit descriptions and canonical details on every dynamic route.
Verify canonical URLs, route coverage, image availability, and that previews match the intended page.
questions.answer_key: Verify canonical URLs, route coverage, image availability, and that previews match the intended page.
questions.explanation: Sitemaps and social metadata need validation and should not expose private routes or misleading content.
